policy.dedup: DOI first; a DOI-less exact-normalized title joins one unambiguous DOI only. Different explicit DOIs never merge. Otherwise exact normalized title; missing identity stays record-specific.
policy.title_normalization: Unicode NFKC/casefold/whitespace; strip BibTeX grouping braces and literal escaped ampersand/underscore; no fuzzy aliases/stemming. Unexpanded alphabetic TeX macros disable title-only matching.
policy.known24: Fixed previous24 seed records, DOI/title only. Same title with different explicit DOI is separately reported, not a strict hit.
policy.scope: Mechanical identities only; title/DOI match does not validate publication-version numerical equivalence or core eligibility.
policy.cross_database: Only exact DOI overlaps are merged across databases; unmatched DOI-less/name variants remain unresolved. Conservative record union is not a final screened corpus.
